description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers related to spark logic in an engine control system. It defines an interface for spark handling, ignition control, and related parameters.

methods.name: isInjectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if fuel injection is enabled based on engine parameters.

methods.name: handleSpark
methods.description: Handles ignition spark logic for engine timing and control.

methods.name: initSparkLogic
methods.description: Initializes spark control logic with shared logger.

methods.name: turnSparkPinHigh
methods.description: Sets the spark ignition pin to a high signal to trigger spark.

methods.name: turnSparkPinLow
methods.description: Sets the spark ignition pin to a low signal to end spark.

methods.name: getNumberOfSparks
methods.description: Returns the number of sparks to generate based on engine mode.

methods.name: getCoilDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates the duty cycle for the ignition coil based on RPM.
